major.summary: A same-project cross-run merge/supersede can make deletion of the destination run fail instead of cascading.
major.evidence: The schema permits resolutionRecommendationId to reference any Recommendation in the same project, including another run, and the migration test explicitly permits recommendation_1 in run_1 to resolve to recommendation_2 in run_2. The self-reference is ON DELETE NO ACTION, so deleting run_2 is rejected while run_1 still references it.
major.impact: This violates the accepted requirement that deleting a run cascades its Insights, Recommendations, and normalized children.
major.recommendation: Require merge/supersede destinations to be in the same run, or define another safe cross-run deletion policy, and add dual-provider destination-run deletion coverage.

major.summary: An otherwise exact snooze review replay becomes invalid once its snooze time has passed.
major.evidence: The Zod contract rejects snoozedUntil unless it is later than Date.now() before the service can recognize an exact persisted replay.
major.impact: A delayed retry of a persisted snooze returns validation failure rather than the original decision, breaking idempotency and making retries time-dependent.
major.recommendation: Allow structurally valid expired snooze metadata through parsing, recognize exact replay first, and retain the future requirement for a new transition.

plan_gaps.summary: The plan did not reconcile same-project cross-run resolution with unconditional run cascades.
plan_gaps.evidence: The documents required only a same-project destination while also requiring every run deletion to cascade its graph.
plan_gaps.impact: The implementation could not satisfy both requirements without an additional resolution-scope decision.
plan_gaps.recommendation: Amend ADR-023 and acceptance criteria to make resolution same-run and align schema, service and tests.

do_not_change.summary: Keep immutable graph writes fact-hash guarded and atomic.
do_not_change.evidence: Conditional parent insertion plus fact-hash-gated child insert-selects prevent losing drift from attaching children.
do_not_change.impact: Weakening this would reintroduce partial or contaminated graphs under concurrency.
do_not_change.recommendation: Preserve the current predicates and runBatch semantics during repair.

do_not_change.evidence: The graph links reject cross-project and cross-run evidence attachment.
do_not_change.impact: Weakening these keys would compromise tenant and origin-run isolation.
do_not_change.recommendation: Retain composite project/run keys and cascades.
